classification.difficultyReason: Convert within-group percentages to joint entries, then use the completed table to compare the male conditional probability with the overall probability and decide independence.

inlines.text: In a sports club, 60% of the members are male and 40% are female. Of the male members, 20% prefer tennis, while 25% of the female members prefer tennis.
Enter 40% and 60% as the female and male row totals. Find each tennis entry as a percentage of the whole club, then subtract it from its row total.

answer.worked: The female row and $T$ column give $10\%$.
The male row and $T$ column give $12\%$.
The total of the $\bar{T}$ column is $78\%$.
